The '''Gom system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tregillis sector/Legends|Tregillis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Wanted by Cracken'' translate to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] sighted the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Londrah]] in the system.<ref name="WC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gom system was first mentioned in the supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], published by [[West End Games]] in [[1993]].<ref name="WC" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Gom system in grid square L-15.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
